method.reference: 46 matched traditional names, 7 CSS names, 1 related CSS name; references are comparison choices, not universal physical standards
method.distance: Euclidean distance in OKLab on its 0..1 scale; not CIEDE2000
method.pairs: All 1431 distinct pairs at 1:1, reversed order and 3:3; directional distance at 1:1 through 1:5, tolerance 0.003
method.neutrals: Every selectable color plus white/black at 3:1 through 3:5; lightness tolerance 0.001
method.single: Two copies of each preset compared with its displayed swatch; this checks consistency only
method.raw: Authored pigment before display calibration, not a prediction verified against actual paints
